summary: Align public digital programme partners, funding, procurement and risks. Explore practical governance tools and enrol in the training.
lede: Public digital programme governance helps senior public leaders and programme directors coordinate initiatives across agencies, funders and vendors. Learners practise mapping decision rights and partner accountability, assessing programme capability and evidence, aligning funding with benefits, and managing risks and procurement dependencies. They also build tools for tracking outcomes and reporting progress to executives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and specialists who coordinate public digital programmes across institutional boundaries. It suits professionals who shape governance, funding, procurement, risk and benefits decisions rather than those seeking technical software implementation training.
prerequisites: Prior experience contributing to public programmes, digital initiatives, policy work or donor-funded projects is expected. No coding is required; familiarity with programme planning or risk registers will help you apply the exercises.
